description: $5.00 USDC on Solana - the payment buys one anchored receipt for one Memory Provenance Audit verdict: you supply the submission SHA-256 and the verdict hash from a verdict this service issued, and the service writes those two hashes - and nothing else from the verdict - to Solana in a single memo transaction by the service's own wallet (the anchor write cost is inside the $5.00). The memo is public and permanent; anyone holding the verdict can confirm from the anchor's on-chain time that the pair had been recorded by then. If the write does not confirm after payment settles, the write is owed and completes on a retry with the same payment, with no second charge; if it cannot be completed, the $5.00 is refunded. The audit and pre-check themselves are HTTP-only (the request body is the raw export): POST https://exchangerebel.com/toll/provenance/audit.

submission_sha256.description: The submission SHA-256 from an issued verdict's coverage block.

verdict_hash.description: The verdict hash from the issued verdict.
